_desc: ★ CO-CHANNEL ISOLATION is the SUBJECT, not the setting (spec 2026-07-27-team-plane-static-parity-routing-design §5 = R7; ships as the PAIR s35a/s35b per §10.5, because the expect DSL has no cross-run comparison). 8 nodes on ONE PHY — 870 MHz / BW62.5 / SF6 / sf_list=[6]: the bench's own frequency and SF, no per-node freq/sf/cr override anywhere, so NOTHING is separated by RF. (BW is 62.5 not the bench's 125 for one reason only: at SF6/BW125 t_sym = 0.512 ms and lus warns that step_ms=1 is too coarse to model it. Same SF, same carrier, same single sf_list.) Two interleaved chains: STATIC S1-S2-S3-S4 (no S1<->S3, no S1<->S4) and TEAM 213-234-235-174 (no 213<->235, no 213<->174, no 234<->174) => S1->S4 is 3 static hops and 213->174 is 3 TEAM hops. ★ EVERY static SITS BETWEEN two teammates and hears both (S1 hears 213+234, S2 hears 234+235, S3 hears 235+174), so a leaky implementation has a path available and would VISIBLY take it — that is what makes the isolation controls non-vacuous rather than merely untested, and the P-ISO-F probe below proves it. T3 carries the MIXED LEAF NIBBLE (layer_id 20 = leaf 4 vs 23 = leaf 7 for everyone else), mirroring the bench's leaf-4-vs-7 team, which is the configuration that shipped to metal. All four members are OFF-GRID (mobile_autoregister=false + a pinned team_dad id), like the bench. ★ dv_hop_cap=1 ON THE MEMBERS is what makes 174 genuinely NEVER-HEARD: it clips every >=2-hop team DV entry, so the ONLY mechanism that can resolve a 3-hop teammate is on-demand discovery (§3/T1) + the team REQ_SYNC pull (§3/T4). ⚠ DO NOT 'simplify' this to team_beacon_period_ms: that was tried and it does NOT stop team DV — a member's ORDINARY beacon (beacon_period_ms) is a same-team beacon to its teammates, so the whole team converged by DV in 13 s and the scenario silently stopped testing discovery at all. ★★ A TELEMETRY DEFECT FOUND WHILE AUTHORING THIS, reported not fixed (sim-only telemetry, so not a firmware bug — but it invalidates any analysis that reads `slot`): node_beacon.cpp:876/879 label a beacon-DV merge "primary"/"alt" REGARDLESS of which table was merged, so a same-team beacon's merge into _rt_team is emitted as slot="primary". Only learn_route_via (:74) labels team installs correctly. Proof from the stream, not by reading: with team DV on, T1 emitted {dest:174,slot:"primary"} and then routed a Plane::TEAM send through it — and rt_find(dst,TEAM) hard-forces _rt_team (node_routing.cpp:22), never falling back to _rt. ⇒ the corpus-wide count of slot="team" events UNDERSTATES team route installs by a large factor. ASSERT LABELS: 1-3 transport, 4-20 mechanism (delivery, then the discovery/pull chain, then the §9-Q2 storm ceiling), 21+ isolation controls, then the shared static workload. ★ PROBE MATRIX — measured 2026-07-28 against this file, every probe reverted and the corpus re-run clean: P-T1 (node.cpp:1138 reverted to the pre-T1 `!is_team_peer(dst)`) => 20 FAIL incl. actual_reply="OK error ctr=0 depth=0" on all three team sends = the literal bench string of spec §0. P-T4 (node_query.cpp reverted to the pre-T4 unconditional is_mobile refusal) => 3 FAIL (asserts 10/16/17: the team_sync Q vanishes, and with it the ttl=8 escalation — both live in the same originator antidote block, so assert 10 is attributable to T1∧T4 jointly, not T1 alone). P-ISO-F (the I1 team-scoped-F drop at node_route_discovery.cpp:213 removed) => 31 FAIL incl. 8 A1 (every static installs _rt[213] and _rt[174] — e.g. S1 {dest:213,hops:1,next:213}) + 9 A3 + both storm ceilings (r_tx 6->20, rreq_forward 1->13). P-ISO-Q (the I7 team_sync admission gate removed) => 3 FAIL (S1/S3/S4 emit q_rx opcode 0). ★ s35b stayed at 0 failures under EVERY probe, which is what makes it a genuine control. ⚠ P-T2a (T2's DATA-origin learn disabled) moves NOTHING — the stream is BYTE-IDENTICAL — so s35 does NOT cover T2. Discovery installs the reverse route before any DATA flows, so the origin learn is a no-op refresh here. T2's live detectors stay s23/s24/s25/s26/s34, per its own gate record. A6 (static delivery unchanged by the team plane's presence) and A8 (leaks==0) are cross-run / tool-level: run s35b and diff, and run tools/dm_delivery_breakdown.py — measured 2026-07-28 as IDENTICAL (4/4 100%, h1ack 4/4, mean_hops 3.0, 0 giveup, 0 no_gw, 0 in_flight in both). ⚠ A8 as spec'd is VACUOUS here: `leaks` is a channel-post metric and s35 posts no channels (§1 puts the team channel plane out of scope); the isolation A8 was reaching for is measured directly by the A1/A3/I7 controls instead. A7 needs NO second file: the team DMs at 200000/260000/320000 fly while the statics are IDLE and the ones at 440000/470000 fly inside the loaded window 400000-490000, so statics-idle-vs-loaded is a WITHIN-run A/B (asserts 4-6 vs 7-8).
